verdict.rationale: Cline can run terminal commands (git add, commit, branch, gh pr create) with human-in-the-loop or auto-approve, and Kanban/CLI features mention 'auto-commit' and isolated git worktrees, implying it can stage and commit changes autonomously. However there is no explicit documentation of dedicated commit-message generation, branch-naming workflows, or PR-creation tooling/integration (e.g., GitHub PR API) — this is inferred from general shell/tool-use capability rather than a named feature. Missing for 10: explicit docs on generating commit messages, branch creation workflow, and native PR-opening capability (vs. just running arbitrary terminal commands), plus independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
